TelegramGuide: useAdvancedMessages
## 高级消息
用于不适合常驻 brief 的消息流程：转发、复制、评论、引用、定时消息、网页预览、reaction 用户和消息关联查询。
调用本 guide 方法只会把本文注入上下文；真正执行时直接调用下面的 `telegram.<method>(...)`。这些方法会由 adapter 通过同名 mtcute high-level method 转发给当前登录的 mtcute client。
## 使用要点
- `answer*`、`reply*`、`comment*` 需要已有 mtcute `Message` 对象；如果只有 message id，先用常驻 `getMessages` 或相应检索 API 获取消息对象。
- 转发、复制、评论、引用和定时发送都会改变聊天内容，调用前确认目标 chat。
## mtcute high-level API
### telegram.answerText
Send a text to the same chat (and topic, if applicable) as a given message
```ts
telegram.answerText(message: Message, ...params: ParametersSkip2<typeof sendText>): ReturnType<typeof sendText>;
```
### telegram.answerMedia
Send a media to the same chat (and topic, if applicable) as a given message
```ts
telegram.answerMedia(message: Message, ...params: ParametersSkip2<typeof sendMedia>): ReturnType<typeof sendMedia>;
```
### telegram.answerMediaGroup
Send a media group to the same chat (and topic, if applicable) as a given message
```ts
telegram.answerMediaGroup(message: Message, ...params: ParametersSkip2<typeof sendMediaGroup>): ReturnType<typeof sendMediaGroup>;
```
### telegram.commentText
Send a text comment to a given message.

If this is a normal message (not a channel post),
a simple reply will be sent.

**Available**: ✅ both users and bots

@throws MtArgumentError
    If this is a channel post which does not have comments section.
    To check if a post has comments, use Message#replies.hasComments
```ts
telegram.commentText(message: Message, ...params: ParametersSkip2<typeof sendText>): ReturnType<typeof sendText>;
```

### telegram.sendCopy
Copy a message (i.e. send the same message, but do not forward it).

Note that if the message contains a webpage,
it will be copied simply as a text message,
and if the message contains an invoice,
it can't be copied.
**Available**: ✅ both users and bots
```ts
telegram.sendCopy(params: SendCopyParams & ({
        /** Source chat ID */
        fromChatId: InputPeerLike;
        /** Message ID to forward */
        message: number;
    } | {
        message: Message;
    })): Promise<Message>;
```
### telegram.sendCopyGroup
Copy a message group (i.e. send the same message group, but do not forward it).

Note that all the provided messages must be in the same message group
**Available**: ✅ both users and bots
```ts
telegram.sendCopyGroup(params: SendCopyGroupParams & ({
        /** Source chat ID */
        fromChatId: InputPeerLike;
        /** Message IDs to forward */
        messages: number[];
    } | {
        messages: Message[];
    })): Promise<Message[]>;
```

### telegram.getDiscussionMessage
Get discussion message for some channel post.

Returns `null` if the post does not have a discussion
message.

This method might throw `FLOOD_WAIT_X` error in case
the discussion message was not *yet* created. Error
is usually handled by the client, but if you disabled that,
you'll need to handle it manually.

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param peer  Channel where the post was found
@param message  ID of the channel post
```ts
telegram.getDiscussionMessage(params: InputMessageId): Promise<Message | null>;
```
### telegram.getFactCheck
Get fact check information for one or more messages in a chat

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param chatId  Chat where the messages are located
@param msgIds  One or more message IDs
```ts
telegram.getFactCheck(chatId: InputPeerLike, msgIds: MaybeArray<number>): Promise<(FactCheck | null)[]>;
```
### telegram.getMessageByLink
Given a message link (e.g. `t.me/durov/1`), fetch the relevant message.
**Available**: ✅ both users and bots
```ts
telegram.getMessageByLink(link: string): Promise<Message | null>;
```

**Available**: ✅ both users and bots

@param chatId  Chat ID

```ts

```
### telegram.getReactionUsers
Get users who have reacted to the message.

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param params
```ts
telegram.getReactionUsers(params: InputMessageId & {
        /**
         * Get only reactions with the specified emoji
         */
        emoji?: InputReaction;
        /**
         * Limit the number of users returned.
         *
         * @default  100
         */
        limit?: number;
        /**
         * Offset for pagination
         */
        offset?: GetReactionUsersOffset;
    }): Promise<ArrayPaginated<PeerReaction, GetReactionUsersOffset>>;
```
### telegram.iterReactionUsers
Iterate over users who have reacted to the message.

Wrapper over getReactionUsers.

**Available**: ✅ both users and bots

@param chatId  Chat ID
@param messageId  Message ID
@param params
```ts
telegram.iterReactionUsers(params: Parameters<typeof getReactionUsers>[1] & {
        /**
         * Limit the number of events returned.
         *
         * @default  `Infinity`, i.e. all events are returned
         */
        limit?: number;
        /**
         * Chunk size, usually not needed.
         *
         * @default  100
         */
        chunkSize?: number;
    }): AsyncIterableIterator<PeerReaction>;
```
### telegram.getReplyTo
For messages containing a reply, fetch the message that is being replied.

Note that even if a message has replyToMessage,
the message itself may have been deleted, in which case
this method will also return `null`.
**Available**: ✅ both users and bots
```ts
telegram.getReplyTo(message: Message): Promise<Message | null>;
```
### telegram.getScheduledMessages
Get scheduled messages in chat by their IDs

For messages that were not found, `null` will be
returned at that position.

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param chatId  Chat's marked ID, its username, phone or `"me"` or `"self"`
@param messageIds  Scheduled messages IDs
```ts
telegram.getScheduledMessages(chatId: InputPeerLike, messageIds: MaybeArray<number>): Promise<(Message | null)[]>;
```
### telegram.getAllScheduledMessages
Get all scheduled messages in chat

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param chatId  Chat's marked ID, its username, phone or `"me"` or `"self"`
```ts
telegram.getAllScheduledMessages(chatId: InputPeerLike): Promise<Message[]>;
```
### telegram.deleteScheduledMessages
Delete scheduled messages by their IDs.

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param chatId  Chat's marked ID, its username, phone or `"me"` or `"self"`.
@param ids  Message(s) ID(s) to delete.
```ts
telegram.deleteScheduledMessages(chatId: InputPeerLike, ids: number[]): Promise<void>;
```
### telegram.sendScheduled
Send previously scheduled message(s)

Note that if the message belongs to a media group,
the entire group will be sent, and all the messages
will be returned.

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param peer  Chat where the messages were scheduled
@param ids  ID(s) of the messages
```ts
telegram.sendScheduled(peer: InputPeerLike, ids: MaybeArray<number>): Promise<Message[]>;
```
### telegram.getWebPagePreview
Get a preview of a web page contained in the message

**Available**: 👤 users only

@param text  Text of the message, or simply the link for which the preview should be retrieved
```ts
telegram.getWebPagePreview(text: InputText): Promise<WebPageMedia | null>;
```

 * Parameters for methods that accept a message
 * 
 * Either a message object (in `message` field), or a chat ID and a message ID

### InputPeerLike

Source: `node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/types/peers/peer.d.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Type that can be used as an input peer to most of the high-level methods. Can be:
 *  - `number`, representing peer's marked ID*
 *  - `string`, representing user's username
 *  - `"me"` and `"self"` which will be replaced with the current user/bot
 *  - Any object with `inputPeer: tl.TypeInputPeer` property
 *  - Raw TL object
 * 
 * > * Telegram has moved to int64 IDs. Though, Levin [has confirmed](https://t.me/tdlibchat/25071)
 * > that new IDs *will* still fit into int53, meaning JS integers are fine.
 */
export type InputPeerLike = 'me' | 'self' | 'some_username' | (string & {}) | number | tl.TypePeer | tl.TypeInputPeer | tl.TypeInputUser | tl.TypeInputChannel | tl.RawUser | tl.RawChannel | tl.RawChat | {
    inputPeer: tl.TypeInputPeer;
};
```
